description: Agent2Q is designed to ingest and analyze file-based data (such as Excel and PDB files) and web-sourced information (like Wikipedia and scientific papers). It utilizes Python and Biopython for data parsing and computations, including calculating distances, velocities, and percentages. The agent can filter and aggregate data based on specific criteria, such as beak lengths and food categories, and outputs formatted numerical results with the required precision and units.

tools.name: FileIO
tools.description: Handles reading and writing of file-based data, such as Excel and PDB files, allowing the agent to ingest and output data in various formats.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: Enables the agent to browse the web for information, including scientific papers and Wikipedia articles, to gather relevant data.

tools.name: PythonExecutor
tools.description: Executes Python and Biopython code for data parsing and computations, such as calculating distances and velocities.

tools.name: DataParser
tools.description: Parses ingested data to extract relevant information and transform it into a usable format for analysis.

tools.name: DataAggregator
tools.description: Aggregates and filters data based on specified criteria, allowing for focused analysis of specific data subsets.

tools.name: ResultFormatter
tools.description: Formats the numerical results with the required precision and units for clear output presentation.
